title: Cynara Invitation Profile Snapshot Schema
description: Canonical contract for the profile and capability set an administrator attaches to an invitation. actorId and capabilities drive acceptance; profile fields are informational metadata never captured at acceptance.

actorId.description: Professional identifier of the invited member within the hospital.

items.description: Capability code to grant at acceptance; the acceptance catalog gates supported codes.

capabilities.description: Capability codes to grant to the invited member.

name.description: Informational given name; never captured at acceptance.

surname.description: Informational family name; never captured at acceptance.

phone.description: Informational contact phone; never captured at acceptance.

language.description: Informational preferred language; never captured at acceptance.

profile.description: Optional informational profile metadata. Acceptance never captures these fields (password-only).
